title: API Rate Limits and Usage
content:
# API Rate Limits and Usage

## Rate Limits by Plan

| Plan | Requests/Day | Requests/Minute | Burst Limit |
|------|-------------|-----------------|-------------|
| Starter | N/A (no API access) | N/A | N/A |
| Pro | 10,000 | 100 | 200 |
| Enterprise | 100,000 | 1,000 | 2,000 |

## Rate Limit Headers

Every API response includes rate limit headers:
- `X-RateLimit-Limit`: Maximum requests per minute.
- `X-RateLimit-Remaining`: Requests remaining in the current window.
- `X-RateLimit-Reset`: Unix timestamp when the limit resets.

## When You Hit the Limit

- API returns HTTP `429 Too Many Requests`.
- Response body includes `retry_after` (seconds to wait).
- Implement exponential backoff in your client code.

## Best Practices

1. **Cache responses** where possible to reduce API calls.
2. **Use webhooks** instead of polling for real-time data.
3. **Batch requests** when querying multiple metrics.
4. **Monitor usage** via **Settings > API > Usage Dashboard**.

## Requesting Higher Limits

Enterprise customers can request custom rate limits by contacting their dedicated support engineer. Custom limits are evaluated based on use case and infrastructure capacity.
